claims.scope: OR of floor(lambda*2^r) disjoint r-bit point defects, for every fixed lambda>0 as r tends to infinity.
claims.statement: U-I tends to an explicit strictly positive Psi(lambda), G-I tends to zero (including lambda=ln 2), and hence G-(1-b)I-bU tends to -b Psi(lambda) for every fixed b in (0,1).
not_claimed: uniformity as b tends to zero or lambda tends to 0 or infinity
